question: Does the measured image distinguish the letters between kappa and omega in the competing transcriptions oikon and oikeion? Greek strings and exact editorial scope are recorded in the report.

prior_art.Carrera_2022: Printed p342, PDF p367, figure230: longer spelling; image-based reading is already published.
prior_art.Young_2025: Section49(48):12a Sym agrees with the longer spelling and discusses its lexical relation to the shorter form.
prior_art.Mercati_1958: Shorter spelling as reported by Carrera and Young; original edition not yet consulted in this run.

selection: Chosen from ten public sample pages after navigating published KTK02 derivatives; no claim of a blinded reading.
coordinate_frame: Stored 8176x6132 image pixels, x rightward, y downward, no rotation; lower text upright and upper text inverted in the published frame.
capture_folder: Captures-Narrowband-NoGamma for MB codes; Captures-Fluorescence-NoGamma for WBUV codes
processing: Acquire exact uncompressed 16-bit pixels with validated HTTP byte ranges; retain original crop bytes and range receipts.
No interpolation, synthetic letters, inpainting, OCR, language model completion, or generative processing.
Show each measured crop at its stored geometry, with one fixed 1st/99th percentile stretch per context.
Published KTK02 RGB separation R-(G+B)/2 is navigation only, not a new measured exposure.
Compare nearby undertext and overtext shapes before interpreting the target. Do not combine bands with unverified geometry.
acceptance: Require attributable undertext shapes at the fixed position, not brightness or a metric alone.
A clearer reproduction of Carrera's existing word is a control result, not a newly recovered reading.
No change to the Bible, Hebrew reconstruction, or original Symmachus text follows automatically from what this medieval witness says.
followup_if_promising: Page60 line2 column4: check the obscured nomen sacrum reported by Mercati but not confirmed by Carrera (printed pp243-244). Freeze its locator and processing before inspecting additional measured crops.
stop_rule: Do not optimize filters against an expected spelling. If all five fixed views remain ambiguous, retain the uncertainty and require a genuinely different measurement or stronger source control.
